business_scope.primary_industry_name: Proprietary Ultra-Low Latency Algorithmic Market Making

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of Panama (unitary national jurisdiction; Panama City registered-office jurisdiction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law with Anglo-American corporate and maritime-law overlay; statutory commercial code (Código de Comercio) and special company law (Ley 32 de 1927)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (FTA, effective 31 Oct 2012)
OECD/G20 Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 2015 (as amended by Ley 52 de 2016 and Ley 70 de 2019) on prevention of money laundering, terrorist financing and WMD proliferation financing; Decreto Ejecutivo 295 de 2016; Ley 254 de 2024 establishing the central UBO register ('Registro de Beneficiarios Finales'); Ley 32 de 1927 on Sociedades Anónimas; Código de Comercio (Art. 54 et seq.); binding regulatory guidance from the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF) and the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); Ley 67 de 2011 (securities market) where regulated licensing is elected.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of beneficial owner photo passport or national ID
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Civil registry, electoral body, or notary in the owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (for non-Apostille states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / corporate extract of any corporate UBO shareholder (parent entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the UBO's state of incorporation (e.g., Delaware Division of Corporations, UK Companies House)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (POA) appointing the Panamanian Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the place of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of ultimate parent/UBO authorizing the Panamanian incorporation and officer appointments
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Secretary or board of directors of the ultimate parent/UBO entity

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Owner declaration form (Declaración de Beneficiario Final) and AML risk questionnaire
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian registered agent firm / law firm certifying completion of due diligence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers and authorized traders against (i) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions, (ii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and (iv) Panamanian UAF/SSNF watchlists. PEP status must be checked per Ley 23 de 2015 Art. 5 (including family members and close associates); re-screening required within 48 hours of any beneficial ownership change and at least annually. Proprietary algorithmic trading assessed as Low_Risk_Standard, allowing simplified CDD on the legal entity while requiring full UBO traceability and source-of-funds evidence for USD clearing rails (Fedwire, Direct Exchange Clearing).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – online name consultation and reservation portal (https://www.registro-publico.gob.pa) and public counters at the Estafeta del Registro Público, Ancón, Panama
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish-form names are preferred; foreign-language and English denominations are admissible in Latin script and must terminate in a Panamanian corporate token (S.A., Corp., Inc.); non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin script; the registry rejects names containing more than five tokens (approximately three content words plus the legal-form suffix) and homonyms of existing trademarks or registrations.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No formal extension of the 30-day window exists; a re-filing with a new fee at the same portal re-establishes the reservation. Upon written name rejection, the applicant or counsel must file a 'Recurso de Apelación' with the Dirección General del Registro Público within 10 business days of notice, attaching DIGERPI trademark-clearance evidence, prior-user or goodwill proof, and a comparative table of registry precedents; alternatively, a modified distinctive name may be filed immediately to avoid delay. A second denial closes appeal unless a new administrative instance is opened under the Ley 38 de 2000.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for corporation formation only as an auxiliary address: the law mandates a resident agent with a physical agency office ('Agencia Registral') in Panama, which constitutes the legal domicile for service of process. A virtual or co-working office may be used to display the 'sede social' for book-keeping, but the licensed proprietary ultra-low-latency trading activity and its USD clearing rails (Fedwire, Direct Exchange Clearing) will require demonstrable operational substance (board-venue records, local compliance files, data-policy documentation) before counterparty banks and exchanges accept the vehicle.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 15% for a purely proprietary unlicensed trading S.A. in the first 24 months; approximately 45% over a 3-year horizon if an SMV (Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores) license, clearing membership, or regulated-broker relationship is active, due to UAF and SMV unannounced AML/CFT site-inspection programs; shelf/dormant structures carrying a residual 10% inspection frequency.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding and UBO verification work (CDD file compilation, PEP/sanctions screening)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 sobre Sociedades Anónimas (as amended), Articles 1–25 (incorporation), 26–50 (capital, shares); supplemented by the Código de Comercio, Book II.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section (Escribanía de Sociedades)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Pacto Social y Estatutos (Public Deed) executed before a Panamanian Notary
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum authorized capital of US$10,000 required; no minimum paid-up capital at formation and no mandatory escrow account.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the corporation accepts the subscription of the authorized common shares by the initial subscribers; that the registered office is established at the address of the registered agent in Panama City; that share certificates be issued and a bank account opened subject to AML verification; that [Name] and [Name] are appointed as the directors for the statutory term; that the directors may act individually or jointly; that the President and Treasurer are authorized to execute all instruments required to open bank accounts, hire third-party administrators, and obtain all operating and financial licenses; and that any officer may certify true copies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Department of Intellectual Property (Mercantile)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online or in-person application for a 'Certificado de Búsqueda' covering at least three proposed corporate names. Pay the search fee and obtain a name clearance certificate (Sabana).
required_dossiers: Identity documents of the applicant or counsel
Proof of payment of search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is pre-registered, file a formal request for reconsideration with alternative names or a memorandum of objection within 5 business days; refile with a new proposed list.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Pacto Social (Articles of Incorporation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública, Republic of Panama (selected notary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Spanish-language Pacto Social y Estatutos. The notary reviews the draft, verifies the name clearance certificate, and executes the public deed with the founders or their attorney-in-fact. Obtain first- and second-copy testimonios.
required_dossiers: Passport or identity cards of founders
Original power of attorney if acting through counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary observes defects, correct the draft and resubmit for execution; any notarial objection is cured by an additional addendum prepared by counsel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Subdepartment (Escribanía de Sociedades)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarial deed together with a memorial de inscripción. The Registry assigns a corporate identifier (ficha) and issues the Certificate of Incorporation (Inscripción de Sociedad Anónima).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry files a 'reparo' (defect), respond within the statutory curing period by filing corrective documents or a brief; if rejected, file an administrative appeal to the Directora General of the Public Registry within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with the General Directorate of Revenue (DGI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Aviso de Operación and tax identification application. Obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) certificate and NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria).
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation from Public Registry
Power of attorney to local representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, correct the submitted data and resubmit; appeal any denial to the Director General of Revenue within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operation License and Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal de Panamá – Treasury Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the municipal operation notice with the Municipality of Panama where the registered office is located. The municipality assesses the annual operation license fee based on estimated revenue and issues the patente municipal.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or building use permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit clarifications regarding the fee calculation; request a reassessment or appeal to the Municipal Council if the assessment is disputed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) as Employer
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) – Dirección Nacional de Afiliación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation as an employer and each employee in the CSS system. File monthly payroll declarations and occupational hazard registrations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any duplicate or missing records by filing corrective declarations; if a penalty is assessed, submit a cure letter with evidence and request administrative reconsideration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá (SMV) for securities and market-making activities; Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) for general industrial and commercial registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Casa de Valores (Securities House License) under Decree-Law No. 1 of 1999, as amended, for market-making and proprietary trading; alternatively, a Registration of Market Operator if acting only for self-account.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE), Republic of Panama
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I (Registration/EIA Statement) for standard office use; Category II (Semidetailed EIA Study) if constructing a physical trading floor or data center with advanced electronic infrastructure; exempt for fully virtual operations without physical premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Executive Decree No. 21 of 2010 (wastewater discharge), Air Quality Decree No. 85 of 2018 (emissions), and Resolution No. 0871 of 2021 (electronic waste handling). No significant VOC emissions from office/data-center operations; mandatory waste segregation and safe disposal of e-waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load inspection for server racks and equipment by municipal engineers; occupational health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Labor (MITRADEL) and CSS Risk Division for the workplace.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); official tax administration portal: https://dgi.mef.gob.pa and the 'Sede Electrónica' taxpayer portal for online registration and filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Panamanian Sociedad Anónima must: (1) incorporate and register with the Public Registry through a licensed resident agent; (2) file the Aviso de Operación (Business Notice) with the DGI; (3) register in the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) database and obtain the RUC tax identification number; (4) obtain the Ficha de Registro de Contribuyente and activate an electronic mailbox (buzón fiscal) in the DGI portal; (5) obtain a qualified electronic signature (Firma Digital) recognized by Panama for electronic filings and e-invoicing. The RUC must be obtained before starting business operations, and the S.A. must maintain its resident agent, corporate books, and updated share register.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope / Entity_Level_Taxation. A Panama S.A. is a separate legal taxable entity; it is not a pass-through vehicle. Corporate income tax applies at the entity level only to Panama-source income; non-Panama-source income of an S.A. with effective management outside Panama is outside the territorial tax net and is not subject to Panamanian corporate income tax unless it becomes Panamanian-source under specific statutory rules.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not have a US-style 'check-the-box' election for a Sociedad Anónima. Available statutory elections and regimes include: (i) cash vs. accrual accounting election for small taxpayers under the Código Fiscal; (ii) election to be taxed as a Panama Pacifico or SEM (Sede de Empresas Multinacionales) qualifying entity with special incentives, subject to meeting employment and investment thresholds; (iii) election to apply simplified transfer-pricing documentation for low-risk intercompany services if under the de minimis threshold; (iv) the option to voluntarily register for ITBMS despite being below the registration threshold in order to claim input tax credits; and (v) for holding/trading vehicles, election to treat certain treasury and market-making transactions as offshore non-Panama-source income when the operative activity takes place abroad.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios), a value-added consumption tax on goods and services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/.36,000 per calendar year of gross taxable sales of goods and services (Balboa/Panama Calificado; B/.1.00 = USD 1.00); registration is mandatory for taxpayers that exceed this economic threshold, and is also required for all importers and exporters regardless of annual sales volume.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing applies to taxpayers required to register for ITBMS. The DGI operates the Sistema de Facturación Electrónica (e-invoicing platform) requiring XML e-invoices with a unique sequential folio, digital signature of the taxpayer or authorized software provider, and transmission to the DGI in near real time for validation, digital stamping, and issuance of an acceptance message with a QR code. Invoices must be issued through DGI-authorized billing software or the DGI online portal; API integration and secure authentication are mandatory for high-volume taxpayers. Transitional paper invoices require express DGI authorization and are subject to inspection visit controls. E-invoice records must be retained for six years, and debit/credit notes must similarly obtain fiscal validation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: ITBMS zero-rating applies to: (i) physical export of tangible goods from Panama, provided the goods leave Panama within the legally established period and the exporter is the registered seller; (ii) services performed and effectively used outside Panama by non-resident recipients, including proprietary offshore algorithmic market-making and sub-trading services rendered through foreign clearing and settlement systems; and (iii) sales of goods and related services to qualifying free zones (Zona Libre de Colón, Panamá Pacífico, and other special economic zones), subject to their administrative regimes. To claim zero-rating, the taxpayer must sustain that the benefit of the service is realized outside Panamanian territory, evidenced by contracts, trading platform execution logs, Fedwire/Direct Exchange Clearing transaction records, clearing statements, and invoices to non-resident counterparties. If the HFT trading entity has routine decision-making and operational control in Panama, the DGI may recharacterize the service as Panamanian-source and apply 7% ITBMS, so the offshore substance evidence must be contemporaneous.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) accepted by the National Customs Authority (ANA), including the bill of lading/airway bill and exporting invoice
Original Bill of Lading or transport document evidencing physical departure of the goods from Panama (not applicable to pure offshore services)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas) from a licensed Panamanian bank evidencing repatriation of export sale proceeds into Panama
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to DGI and ANA joint audit scrutiny. If the DGI determines that the taxpayer failed to substantiate the export, the services were actually consumed in Panama, or the goods never left Panamanian territory, it will issue a retrospective clawback of the zero rate, assessing the 7% ITBMS plus compensatory interest from the original invoice date. Administrative fines under the Código Fiscal and fiscal legislation apply, typically ranging from B/.500 to B/.20,000 per infraction, with additional penalties equal to 100% of the omitted tax in cases of fraudulent mis-declaration. Knowingly issuing false export invoices or using forged customs documents can trigger criminal fraud charges under Panama's Criminal Code, the suspension or cancellation of the RUC and export-trade licenses, and civil liability for directors, the resident agent, and authorized signatories. The standard ITBMS statute of limitations generally permits DGI assessment within five years, which may be extended in cases of omitted filings or concealed offshore arrangements.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) as the banking and AML/CFT supervisory authority; monetary authority is effectively the U.S. Federal Reserve because Panama is fully dollarized; Banco Nacional de Panamá performs certain fiscal agency functions but is not a central bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility and complete dollarization. Panama maintains no legal distinction between current and capital account convertibility, and there are no exchange controls, surrender rules, or repatriation limits. Dividends, interest, royalties, trading profits, liquidation proceeds, and capital returns are freely remittable in U.S. dollars. The only practical constraints are SBP-mandated AML/KYC documentary requirements and the need to evidence lawful source of funds for tax and regulatory transparency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory surrender or mandatory conversion of export proceeds. Export receipts may be retained abroad or in any local USD account without any Central Bank approval, timeline, or exchange-rate conversion. Books and records must still be retained for DGI (Dirección General de Ingresos) and SBP AML inspection purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Main Operational Account / Trading Liquidity Account
Capital Escrow Account / Reserve Operating Account
Capital Escrow Account / Main Operating Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Panama's banking law reserves deposit-taking and settlement functions to SBP-licensed banks. Offshore digital EMIs are not directly chartered to open local clearing accounts or hold client funds in Panama. They may serve as payment-instrument gateways only if contractually backed by a licensed correspondent bank and approved by the receiving Panama institution. For a high-frequency treasury operation, an offshore EMI is not a substitute for a Tier-1 bank relationship; at most it is a supplementary API-accessible payment channel with heightened operational risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No absolute statutory mandate requiring directors to appear physically. SBP and bank policies permit remote/video KYC interviews under Law 23 of 2015 and related regulations when supported by certified document authentication, independent database checks, and a local AML compliance agent. In practice, for proprietary HFT treasury vehicles with large cross-border flows, banks often require one in-person or notarized interview of the legal representative and beneficial owner, together with apostilled corporate resolutions and original or certified identification documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Panama-registered S.A. with single foreign owner and opaque or bearer-share history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified share register under the Panama Companies Law (Ley 32 de 1927); bearer-share custodial immobilization certificate from a licensed custodian; apostilled certificate of incumbency; notarized director and shareholder resolutions; FATCA/CRS tax classification documentation; Form W-8BEN-E if U.S. reportable; registered agent certificate confirming no bearer-share mobility.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Algorithmic high-frequency trading returns lacking visible economic substance or operational footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements for the last three years; trading strategy description and backtest documentation; live clearing and broker statements; exchange trade logs; independent valuation of assets; evidence of physical technology infrastructure, staff costs, and data-feed agreements; certification by a licensed public accountant on revenue reconciliation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionately high wire velocity and multiple cross-border counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury policy and transaction volume thresholds; counterparty KYC files for each prime broker and exchange; OFAC and sanctions screening results; daily balance and settlement records; audit trail of wire instructions; pre-approved high-velocity payment rulebook with compliance oversight; description of kill-switch and transaction limits.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 from the ultimate shareholder's bank to the Panama account-beneficiary bank, with field 70 containing 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / PANAMA S.A. OPERATIONAL ACCOUNT'. Because Panama has no FX-control approval regime, no Central Bank filing is required; the only gate is SBP-compliant KYC/AML verification and the bank's internal source-of-wealth check. If the receiving bank has a Federal Reserve master account, Fedwire can be used for same-day USD settlement (e.g., Banco Nacional de Panamá). Documentary support should include the corporate resolution, a capital injection certificate, UBO declaration, and the notarized/apostilled register.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements may be executed via SWIFT MT103/202 for direct transfer, or through commercial letters of credit under UCP600 (MT700/MT707) when a goods or services supply chain is involved. For proprietary HFT operating payments, preferred rails are SWIFT MT103 with structured remittance data and Fedwire for USD-domestic instant settlement. Local Panamanian USD clearing via ACH Panama may be used for operational expenses, but exchange and prime-broker settlements should be routed through direct Fedwire or SWIFT to maintain time-critical finality.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/PAB FX risk is structurally nil under Panama's 1:1 dollarized system, so no floating-currency hedge is required for local balances
Exchange-traded stock index and single-stock futures/options in USD to hedge inventory and market exposure
USD interest-rate swaps and basis swaps to hedge cost-of-carry on leveraged trading positions
FX forwards and NDFs on non-USD working currencies (EUR, GBP, JPY) where prime broker margin or exchange collateral is held abroad
Cross-currency swaps for non-USD trading accounts and margin sweeps, subject to bank credit-limit approval and SBP derivatives governance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) through authorized bank portals; recorded at the Registro Público de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 15 for the preceding calendar period; no extension available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment after March 15 incurs a US$50 surcharge; continued non-payment prevents issuance of certificates of good standing; after three consecutive unpaid years, the Public Registry commences administrative strike-off and dissolution proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory external audit applies to a standard offshore Sociedad Anónima under Panama's territorial tax regime. A certified audit becomes compulsory only if the entity is registered with the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores, qualifies as a gran contribuyente (large taxpayer), or operates under a special regulated regime requiring audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panamanian NIF (Normas de Información Financiera), substantially convergent with IFRS; statutory records must be maintained in Spanish and denominated in USD.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial ownership records must be maintained by the resident agent under Law 21 of 2017 and Law 254 of 2021. Every share transfer must be documented in the Register of Members and the agent must be notified within 30 days. No separate annual UBO filing to DGI is required, but resident agents routinely obtain an annual signed confirmation from the company to keep the UBO register accurate and available for inspection.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 900 – USD 3,500 per engagement (when voluntary audit or licensed activity requires a certified statement)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: only Panama-source income is taxable; foreign-source proprietary trading gains are exempt. Reduced rate of 15% applies to the first USD 50,000 of taxable income for taxpayers whose consolidated taxable income does not exceed USD 1,500,000. Special regimes available: Panamá Pacífico Special Economic Zone (full income tax exemption), Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime (effective 5% rate on qualifying Panamanian-source services), and Ciudad del Saber exemptions. No withholding or Panama CIT on dividends distributed from foreign-source profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 120 (Declaración Anual de Rentas y Operaciones) filed electronically through the DGI e-Tax portal (SETA / dgi.mef.gob.pa).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; monthly advance payments (Anticipos) are required for taxpayers whose prior-year tax liability exceeded USD 46,000.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for a standard December 31 fiscal year-end, the filing deadline is March 31 of the following year. No automatic extension; a one-time 2-month extension may be granted upon prior request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income (Ingresos Brutos Gravables) derived from Panama-source activities, including Panamanian market-making, clearing, and exchange rebates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income with Panamanian source; proprietary HFT gains generated through foreign exchanges, Fedwire settlement, and non-Panama clients are excluded by territorial law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable income and foreign-source income (Ingresos Exentos y de Fuente Extranjera), supported by documentary evidence of extraterritorial execution.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a transactional summary identifying the clear chain of broking, matching, and clearing activity outside Panama; risk of reclassification if servers, staff, or counterparties are located in Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and expenses (Costos y Gastos Deducibles) attributable to taxable Panamanian-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses attributable to foreign-source income may not be netted against Panama-source revenue; maintain contemporaneous expense allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income (Renta Neta Imponible) after cost of sales, expenses, and loss carryforwards (maximum 5 years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Carryforward losses may only offset Panama-source taxable income; foreign trading losses are non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax determined (ISR a cargo) at 15%/25% progressive schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Computed exclusively on Panama-source net income; foreign tax credits are not applicable under territorial law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholdings applied at source (Retenciones Sufridas) and advance tax payments (Anticipos) credited against final liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify broker, exchange, and clearinghouse Panama-source WHT certificates before claiming credit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or balance in favor (Saldo a Pagar / Saldo a Favor).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be wired to DGI collection accounts in USD; zero-balance filings for fully foreign-source HFT operations are acceptable only if documentation is complete.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fine from USD 50 to USD 5,000 for formal non-compliance; late payment: monthly surcharge (recargo) of 1.5% on the unpaid tax, capped at 50%, plus moratory interest of 1% per month. Failure to file electronically triggers suspension of tax clearance certificate (Paz y Salvo).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% on cash dividends distributed from Panama-source net profits; 10% applies to dividends paid in excess of distributable taxable profits or when the payor failed to comply with CIT disclosure rules. Dividends paid from foreign-source (non-Panama) profits are not subject to Panamanian dividend WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama maintains a limited DTA network (UK, South Korea, Mexico, Ireland, Uruguay, Spain; Argentina signed but not fully in force; no DTA with the United States). Relief procedure: the Panamanian paying entity retains the reduced rate at source by filing the recipient's Panama DGI-issued Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC), proof of beneficial ownership (Formulario 750 / WHT reduction request), and an affidavit of no Panama permanent establishment. The TRC is obtained from DGI within 10-15 business days. Unilateral deviations are high-risk; treaty benefits are denied where the recipient lacks substance or the transaction is conduit-structured.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 12.5% on royalties and technical assistance fees paid to non-residents; 12.5% on interest paid to non-resident non-bank lenders (5% for interest on registered bank financing). Treaty-reduced rates: e.g., UK DTA: royalties 10%, interest typically 5%; Korea DTA: royalties 10-15%, interest 15%. No WHT applies to trading gains, derivatives, or securities lending fees sourced exclusively abroad.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 250,000: annual aggregate of cross-border related-party transactions exceeding this threshold triggers the mandatory sworn transfer pricing annex (Formulario 1230) to the annual CIT return. Comprehensive Local File style study and documentation are required when the annual related-party transaction value exceeds USD 1,000,000. Panamanian TP rules apply regardless of the entity's net profit; failure to file triggers presumptive adjustments.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama adopted Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) under the EU-driven transparency reforms (Executive Decree 270 of 2021 and DGI Resolution 201-2127). Relevant activities include financing/leasing, IP holding, distribution and service centers, headquarters, shipping, and pure equity holding. A proprietary algorithmic HFT entity that books trades, holds trading platforms, or extends margin/clearing credit from Panama may be classified under the financing/leasing category and must demonstrate: (i) physical premises in Panama; (ii) locally employed qualified staff; (iii) strategic decision-making by directors resident in Panama; and (iv) adequate local expenditure. Annual ESR return is mandatory for qualifying entities; penalties range from USD 10,000 to USD 1,000,000 for false or missing declarations, plus strike-off and exchange-of-information consequences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate mischaracterization of Panama-sourced algorithmic trading profit (e.g., Panamanian servers, Panamanian brokers, or Panamanian risk management staff) as foreign-source income to achieve full territorial exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 50% surcharge on the tax evaded plus full back assessment and moratory interest; criminal conviction under Law 70 of 2019 where the evaded amount exceeds USD 300,000: imprisonment of 3 to 8 years, fines up to double the evaded tax, and publication of the taxpayer's name.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are jointly and severally liable for taxes subject to withhold-and-remit obligations (Article 42 Tax Code); criminal liability may attach to the legal representative who signs the false return; travel bans and exit prohibitions can be imposed during criminal tax proceedings; corporate veil piercing for fraud or sham arrangements exposes personal wealth.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Substance Deficiency (ESR and Beneficial Ownership)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a letterbox S.A. that claims foreign-source HFT income but has no office, no employees, no Panamanian board meetings, and no ESR filing; failing to identify/update ultimate beneficial owners in the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (Law 254 of 2021).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalty from USD 10,000 to USD 1,000,000; immediate cancellation of tax clearance certificate; administrative strike-off of the company; inclusion in the EU/global tax transparency blacklist triggers defensive measures and automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a non-compliant shell entity face personal fines equal to 25% of the company's penalty and are barred from registering new companies in Panama; travel bans may be issued by the DGI; persistent abuse supports piercing of the limited liability veil by creditors and tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Algorithmic trading entity used as an unlicensed payment/clearing conduit to process third-party funds, settle trades on behalf of undisclosed principals, or move USD through Fedwire without a proper AML/CFT compliance framework or suspicious transaction reporting; failure to maintain an AML Compliance Manual and file STR/SAR with UAF.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to USD 1,000,000 per violation; suspension of operations; criminal money laundering penalties of 5 to 10 years imprisonment for predicate offenses and confiscation of trading assets and bank balances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners are personally liable for willful AML non-compliance; international travel bans and asset freezes can be imposed by the Superintendencia de Bancos and UAF; extradition risk exists for predicate tax offenses and money laundering rings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely invoking a Panama DTA to reduce dividend, royalty, or interest WHT for a recipient that lacks beneficial ownership, residency certification, or economic substance (e.g., conduit entity routing HFT profits through the Panama-Korea or Panama-UK treaty to avoid source-country tax).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive denial of treaty benefits, collection of the full 12.5%/25% WHT differential, 50% surcharge, and moratory interest; criminal tax evasion proceedings under Law 70 of 2019 where deliberate; blacklisting from withholding clearance procedures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing officers face joint and several civil liability for the unpaid WHT differential; criminal prosecution for falsification of public documents in the TRC or WHT reduction applications; imprisonment up to 5 years; travel bans pending final assessment.
